newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIGRAFIA IPO SHARES GO TO 670 INVESTORS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIGRAFIA IPO SHARES GO TO 670 INVESTORS.

text.p: Polish printing house Poligrafia SA, which plans to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, sold the 1,357,280 shares at its initial public offering to 670 investors, the firm's president said.
Helena Zych told Reuters on Thursday that 141 investors received shares in the large-investor tranche of 857,280 shares.
She said 529 investors received shares in the small-investor tranche of 500,000 shares.
Shares were sold on a first-come-first-served basis earlier this month.
Poligrafia, which was 88.8-percent owned by Polish construction company Exbud SA before the issue, sold the shares in both tranches at 7.5 zlotys each.

Exbud has said that after the issue it would hold about 55 percent of Poligrafia, which expects to net two million zlotys this year and 2.8 million zlotys in 1997 after last year's 0.8 million zlotys.
